newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: GOLF-PAINTER HOLDS ON TO WIN COOLUM TITLE.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-PAINTER HOLDS ON TO WIN COOLUM TITLE.

text.p: Australian Anthony Painter took his first title on his home golf tour when he won the Coolum Classic by two shots on Sunday.

Painter fired a final round of one-over-par 73 at the Hyatt Resort course in Queensland to finish with an aggregate of eight-under 280 for his biggest win on his home circuit in 11 years as a professional.
Compatriot Matthew Ecob finished second after equalling the course record with a 65 for a total of 282. Ecob stormed up the leaderboard with a round which included eight birdies.
Painter, who led by two shots overnight after successive rounds of 68 on Friday and Saturday, played steady golf over the closing holes to hold off Ecob's late charge.
A group of five players, including Britain's Gary Evans and Michael Long of New Zealand, tied for third.
Long, who last week won the New Zealand Open, birdied the final hole to join Evans and Australians Michael Clayton, Greg Chalmers and Rod Pampling on five-under 283. Evans hit a final round of 68.
